errors.evidence: The description states the F1 value at distance=3 is approximately 77.5, but the data point in the figure is visibly lower, at approximately 77.3 (reference value is 77.2).
The description states the peak F1 value at distance=5 is approximately 77.9, but the data point is clearly above the 78% mark on the y-axis. The reference value is 78.2%.

The description states the peak Acc value at distance=5 is approximately 77.2, but the data point is visibly higher, closer to the middle of the 76-78 range (approximately 77.4, which is the reference value).

The description consistently underestimates the Acc values for distances 2, 3, and 4. The values in the figure are visibly higher, at approximately 76.7, 76.6, and 76.8, respectively, not 76.4 or 76.5.
